description: Session provider bb: runs an instance as one bb thread (Claude Code or pi) through bb's public CLI, at one pinned bb-app version, instead of a tmux session.

bb.description: One bb thread per home, in a bb project rooted at the home. No terminal: open the thread in bb.

server.description: The bb server's address on this host. Loopback only (127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost): bb's API has no login and runs commands. Set it only in oats-local.yaml.

daemon.description: The bb host daemon's address on this host (its /status says when threads can start). Loopback only. Set it only in oats-local.yaml. Unset: the hostDaemonPort on 127.0.0.1 where that is set, and otherwise bb's own default, http://127.0.0.1:38887.

hostDaemonPort.description: The port of this bb's host daemon, a number from 1 to 65535: what bb-app was started with (--host-daemon-port). Set it where the daemon is not on bb's default port (38887), as for a second bb on one host: bb's CLI finds its host daemon by this port alone, and every bb command the provider runs is then told it (BB_HOST_DAEMON_PORT). The daemon setting follows it where that is unset. Unset: no port is told, and bb's CLI uses its default. A BB_HOST_DAEMON_PORT in the environment OATS runs in never reaches bb: the port comes from this setting alone. Set it only in oats-local.yaml.

version.description: The bb-app version this deployment runs, exactly as `bb --version` prints it. The default is the version this release of the provider is contract-tested against. Readiness and every launch refuse another version (E_BACKEND_VERSION).

trust.description: Who can reach bb's loopback port. single-user: this host has one person's user. container: one OATS team container with one bb server. Required (E_BACKEND_TRUST): unlike tmux's socket, the port is open to every local user's processes. Set it only in oats-local.yaml.

cli.description: The bb CLI: a command name on PATH, or an absolute path. Set it only in oats-local.yaml.

dataDir.description: bb's data directory on this host (bb-app's --data-dir), an absolute path. Unset: .bb in the home of the user that runs bb. bb does not say where it is; a launch in bb's sandboxed modes keeps the agent's tools off bb's thread storage there, and is refused where the directory holds no thread-storage. Set it only in oats-local.yaml.

piAgentDir.description: The pi configuration directory bb's server runs pi with (pi's PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR in the bb server's environment), an absolute path. Unset: .pi/agent in the home of the user that runs bb. bb does not say where it is. A pi launch is refused unless its settings.json lists @awebai/oats-pi (E_BACKEND_NOT_READY) and does not list @awebai/pi (E_BACKEND_PI_LISTENER): the provider reads it and never changes it. Set it only in oats-local.yaml.
